title: Acetaminophen Overdose / NAC Dosing

changelog.change: Initial entry from Calculator_Logic_Build_Spec.md Section 3. Treatment-line approximation.

purpose: Plots a serum acetaminophen level against time since a SINGLE acute ingestion relative to the US 150 mcg/mL treatment line, and gives the 21-hour IV NAC regimen weight-based doses.

interpretation.label: At or above the treatment line — start NAC
interpretation.disposition: Begin the 21-hour IV NAC protocol (loading dose above); consult toxicology

interpretation.label: Below the treatment line — NAC not indicated by the nomogram for a single acute ingestion
interpretation.detail: Only valid if the ingestion time is known, single, and acute, and the level was drawn ≥ 4 h post-ingestion.

buildNote: Treatment line is approximated as 150 × 2^(−(h−4)/4) (halves every 4 h from 150 at 4 h). Not valid for unknown-time, staggered/chronic, or > 24 h presentations — those use different criteria. A production build should render the actual semi-log nomogram plot alongside this.
